name: Michael Patrick Flanagan
summary:
Michael Patrick Flanagan (born November 9, 1962) is an American attorney, former politician, and United States Army captain who served as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 5th congressional district from 1995 to 1997. A member of the Republican Party, Flanagan is best known for his victory over eighteen-term congressman Dan Rostenkowski in the 1994 midterm elections.
For beating Rostenkowski, he was given the moniker of the "Rosty-slayer." His victory was one of 58 Republican victories (for a net gain of 54 seats) in the House of Representatives that allowed the party to take control of both houses of Congress, as part of the Republican Revolution.
